title: Run Status Clarity + Validation Summary Completion

items_implemented.name: run_status_clarity
changes: Last-run indicator extended with status badge (OK / ERROR / BLOCKED / NO RUN)
Project association shown when project_record has a code
Scenario association shown when base_case_record has a name
Inline stale/fresh state row (same gate as stale_run macro)
Run error message surfaced in a dedicated row
data-stale-state and data-run-status attributes for downstream CSS
All data sourced from existing context, no fake IDs or timestamps

items_implemented.name: validation_summary_completion
changes: Strict severity order: Error -> Warning -> Information, always rendered
Empty groups show a 'no items' hint row (e.g. 'No errors. Inputs are clear for run.')
Hint subtitle per group ('Must be fixed', 'Review before run', 'FYI only')
data-severity and data-count attributes on each group
aria-label and role attributes on header / passed message

items_implemented.name: empty_state_review
changes: New _empty_no_project.html partial (renders when no project selected)
New _empty_no_scenario.html partial (renders when no scenario for project)
New _empty_no_run.html partial (renders when no run performed yet)
Wired into index.html in order: project -> scenario -> run
